headline: Bahrain Intercepts Iranian Drone Strikes Targeting US Military Facilities
summary: Bahrain intercepted and destroyed several Iranian aerial attacks overnight after Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed it launched six drones targeting a U.S. base on the island. Saudi Arabia condemned the strikes and expressed solidarity with Bahrain.
why: Escalating military conflict in the Persian Gulf risks disrupting regional stability and commercial oil shipping corridors.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Direct military strikes near Middle Eastern oil-producing infrastructure heighten geopolitical risk premiums for crude oil.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Fresh drone attacks on facilities in the Persian Gulf heighten concerns over energy supply security in the Middle East.
